events.artist: Ludi Nomadi — Masahiko Satoh, Keisuke Ohta, Beni Sakai & Tamaya Honda
events.subtitle: Piano, violin, bass and drums in a veteran improvising quartet
events.factual_description: Shinjuku PIT INN presents Ludi Nomadi on Monday, December 7, 2026. Doors are at 19:00 and music starts at 19:30. The quartet is Masahiko Satoh on piano, Keisuke Ohta on violin, Beni Sakai on bass and Tamaya Honda on drums. The venue lists a ¥4,400 charge including tax and one drink, with reservations opening November 1 at 11:00.

en.why_it_matters: Satoh's piano and Ohta's violin give this quartet an unusually open melodic front line, while Sakai and Honda can turn that space into rhythmic risk. The exact instrumentation promises a musician-led improvising night rather than a routine standards set.
en.trip_verdict: A strong option if a Tokyo evening is open. Take it for the quartet conversation, but do not displace a rarer one-off or reorganize a trip around it.

es.why_it_matters: El piano de Satoh y el violín de Ohta dejan un frente melódico especialmente abierto, mientras Sakai y Honda pueden convertir ese espacio en riesgo rítmico. La instrumentación concreta promete una noche de improvisación entre músicos, no otro set rutinario de standards.
es.trip_verdict: Es una gran opción si queda libre una noche en Tokio. La tomaría por la conversación del cuarteto, sin desplazar una ocasión más rara ni reorganizar el viaje por ella.

events.subtitle: Plays BonDance and Something Else — improvisation, festival rhythm and large ensemble
events.category: Japanese experimental big band / improvised Bon dance
events.factual_description: Shinjuku PIT INN presents Otomo Yoshihide Special Big Band Plays BonDance and Something Else on Tuesday, December 29, 2026. Doors are at 19:00 and music starts at 19:30. The seventeen-member published lineup spans guitar, piano, keyboards, clarinet, three saxophones, trumpet, trombone, tuba, accordion, bass, two drum sets, marimba, percussion and sine waves. It closes the night program of Otomo's four-day, eight-concert year-end series, returning after two years under the theme 'Improvisation.' Otomo says the set will mix Bon-dance songs, other compositions and improvisation. Advance tickets are ¥7,700 and same-day tickets ¥8,250, including tax and one drink; sales and reservations open November 1 at 11:00.

provenance.note: Stage 1 admission rests on the documented transformation of Bon-dance songs through a seventeen-piece ensemble built from horns, accordion, marimba, two drummers and sine waves, inside Otomo's explicit year-long inquiry into improvisation. Stage 2 assigns A+: this exact scale and program merit making room. The four-day series and recurring special big band provide multiple Otomo contexts, so no evidence supports S-level scarcity despite the two-year gap. Canonical and inbox searches found no match.

en.why_it_matters: Otomo is not using 'improvisation' as a loose label: he closes a four-day inquiry by throwing Bon-dance songs, composed material and spontaneous form into a seventeen-piece band with accordion, marimba, two drummers and Sachiko M's sine waves. The collision of communal festival rhythm and unstable large-ensemble texture is the specific draw.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for the December 29 night if Tokyo overlaps the year-end run. It is the strongest large-ensemble anchor in the series, though the surrounding seven concerts mean this one date need not carry a whole trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: Otomo no usa «improvisación» como etiqueta vaga: cierra cuatro días de investigación mezclando cantos de Bon Odori, material compuesto y forma espontánea dentro de una banda de diecisiete integrantes, con acordeón, marimba, dos baterías y las ondas sinusoidales de Sachiko M. El cruce entre ritmo festivo comunitario y textura inestable de gran ensamble es el atractivo concreto.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio activamente a la noche del 29 de diciembre si Tokio coincide con la serie de fin de año. Es el ancla de gran ensamble más fuerte del ciclo; las otras siete presentaciones hacen que esta fecha no tenga que sostener por sí sola todo un viaje.
